deadline.value: December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027; fall entry only. Test scores and recommendation letters are due by the same date.
deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall 2027 applications is December 15, 2026.

fee_waiver.value: PhD fee waivers are generally not available to international applicants; domestic applicants can request a code.
fee_waiver.quote: PhD application fee waivers are generally not available for International Students.

also.quote: Domestic PhD Applicants: Before submitting your application, please contact grad-admission@cs.utah.edu to receive a fee waiver code.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional and considered if provided.
gre_general.quote: Optional for Masters and Ph.D. Applicants: If available and provided, it will be taken into consideration for the admission decision.

supervisor.value: The school does not say whether a supervisor must be found before applying.

funding.value: PhD students receive financial support (assistantships with tuition benefit and health insurance) while in the program, conditional on good progress; about USD 13,791 per term in 2026/27.
funding.quote: PhD students in the School of Computing receive financial support while they are in the program, conditional on good progress.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; a computer science degree is not required but strong coding experience is.
entry_route.quote: You may apply if you have received a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited college or university.

also.quote: The Kahlert School of Computing does not require students to have a computer science bachelor's degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Two PhD programs: Computer Science (no tracks) and Computing (with tracks). The school prefers TOEFL 105 / IELTS 7.5 but considers any score above the university minimum.
